# hexcore_vds (Data Source)

Read one VDS by ID, reconciled with the complete account VDS list. Missing or indeterminate objects return errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hexcore_vds" "example" {
  id = "123456"
}

output "ipv4" {
  value = data.hexcore_vds.example.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Positive decimal VDS ID as a string.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Raw API timestamp/date text; no timezone is inferred. Null when unavailable.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Observed disk capacity in GB.
- `ipv4` (String) Observed ipv4; null when unavailable.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Observed memory in MB (1024 MB per custom GB).
- `name` (String) Observed name; null when unavailable.
- `next_bill_date` (String) Raw API timestamp/date text; no timezone is inferred. Null when unavailable.
- `price` (String) Observed price as decimal text, without floating point conversion. Null when unavailable.
- `region` (String) Observed region; null when unavailable.
- `status` (String) Observed status; null when unavailable.
- `vcpu` (Number) Observed virtual CPU count.
